body: This view suggests that French values are intact after decolonisation. As such, much of the public discourse has featured such terms as 'solidarité', complémentarité' and 'réciprocité'.13 The values that ‘coopération' carries show that even if it may superficially be termed 'development aid' by the English-speaking world, in the perspective of France's experience of colonisation and decolonisation, Paris perceives it in a very different manner.
